name: Dynamic Gait Index
description: 8-task gait assessment scored 0–3 each (total 0–24). Tests gait with head turns, obstacle avoidance, stairs, and pivot turns. Admin ~15 min.
shirleySays: ICC 0.96–0.98. MDC: 2.9 pts (stroke), ~4 pts (vestibular). MCID: 1.97 pts (PD). Better ceiling than BBS for higher-functioning patients. Admin time ~15 min.

scoring.mcidNote: 1.97 pts (PD); cut-off <19 = fall risk in community-dwelling elderly
